title: Sharp Controlled Direct Effect Bounds from Summary Causal Graphs over Lag Refinements
banked_reason: The finite semialgebraic envelope and exact unadjusted-contrast frontier are sound, but the advertised generic replayable exact-certification framework lacks an implemented proof-producing QE backend and is assessed subfield.
gap_reasons: The finite raw-program envelope, the contrast-specific MC iff UA frontier, and the rational strict-tightening example are proved, but the advertised total exact certification framework is not fully discharged.
The absence of an implementation, replay artifact, or application beyond constructed witnesses further limits the projected leading-journal score.
What remains is a non-obvious but specialized graphical frontier and finite semialgebraic characterization, not yet the validated reusable compiler advertised by the headline.
proof_attempt_summary: Discovery proved a finite sharp refinement envelope, the exact bounded-window frontier for uniform validity of the unadjusted Ferreira–Assaad contrast, a relative-open strict-tightening witness, simultaneous whole-set inference, and a full-support obstruction to unsafe response-signature quotienting.  A cross-boundary audit repaired the BPR provenance by separating its direct arithmetic/height/sample-point bounds from a paper-owned arithmetic-to-bit lift, and both typed technical panels then passed.  Field-tier delivery still requires an implemented proof-producing exact-QE compiler, trace verifier, endpoint decoder, and executable certificate artifacts; that is a separate project, so the sound theorem package is banked at subfield.
tldr: A finite binary process is observed through a bounded window and a lag-abstracted directed and bidirected summary graph. Directed effects occur only at positive lags through \(L\), while bidirected dependence may span any summary-compatible pair of time points in the observed \(H\)-window. The sharp controlled-micro-direct-effect envelope is the attained range of the raw semi-Markovian polynomial programs over exactly those refinements whose canonical fiber reproduces the observed law; a total exact certifier returns either branchwise incompatibility evidence or isolated algebraic endpoints with attaining SCMs. In the present independent pairwise-edge-latent class, the bounded-window micro condition is necessary and sufficient for the unadjusted Ferreira--Assaad contrast to equal the micro CDE uniformly over every admissible refinement and every strictly positive model. This is an exact frontier for that contrast, not a necessary-and-sufficient identification criterion from the full observed law. The condition permits directed summary cycles through \(Y\) and strictly improves the label-level exclusion, as witnessed by the one-lag summary \(B\to X\to Y\), \(Y\leftrightarrow B\). The envelope is strictly narrower on a relative-open temporal-instrument family than a complete temporal-order comparator, and simultaneous multinomial regions support tie-aware inference. Exact response-signature analysis preserves the image under factorized push-forward, supplies a quotient-size bound and a factor-incidence test, and gives a full-support rational obstruction showing that unrestricted quotient masses erase independent edge-factor incidence; the endpoint compiler therefore retains the raw product parameterization unless the test succeeds. The quotient obstruction is a usable compiler guard: it names the unrestricted Rossetto--Antonucci/Choe-style simplex lift that fails under independent overlapping edge latents, certifies failure at full support, and supplies an exact alternating-block test for the graphs on which quotienting is safe.
gap: Existing summary-graph work identifies micro controlled direct effects only on sufficient graphical regimes; existing automated bounds take one fixed graph; existing order-only quotients use complete response-signature masses and do not preserve nonlinear independent-edge-latent product images.
fill: The project supplies a sharp unquotiented compiler and a total exact certifier, proves the point-identification reduction, and embeds every refinement into the complete order-only comparator by padding unused parents and bundling independent latents. Explicit rational graph-aware and complete-signature primal tables, pointwise dual inequalities, and an interior response-matrix ledger certify relative-open strict tightening. One multinomial event is propagated through all queries and contrasts, while factorization-safe quotienting remains an explicit equality-or-separation question.
